identity.mission: Create a Bloomberg-like, high-density financial terminal that feels alive, not static.
principles: Fusion: Mix Financial Terminal density with Cyberpunk aesthetics.
Density: Every pixel must be utilized. No 'cozy' spacing.
Motion: Data triggers motion. Blinking indicators, sliding tickers.
Contrast: Neon on Void. High contrast is the only option.
hall_of_shame: No 'Soft' Shadows (Use Glows or Hard Borders).

headings.usage: Page Titles, Widget Headers, KPI Values

card.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). 1px solid border (border-zinc-800).

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-sm font-mono uppercase text-xs tracking-wider px-4 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:border-zinc-500 rounded-sm font-mono text-xs px-4 py-2

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-500 rounded-sm font-mono text-sm placeholder:text-zinc-600

charts.style: Minimal axes, grid lines opacity 0.1. Custom Tooltip (Dark bg, neon text).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FRAMER MOTION: 'npm install framer-motion' or 'yarn add framer-motion' is MANDATORY. It is missing in package.json.
THEME SETUP: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the root 'html' or 'body' tag by default. This is a Dark Mode ONLY app.
FONT SETUP: Add '@import' for 'JetBrains Mono' and 'IBM Plex Sans' in 'index.css' from Google Fonts.
GRID BORDERS: Implement a custom 'GridBorder' component that draws 1px borders between grid items to mimic a financial terminal.
TICKER TAPE: Create a 'SignalTicker' component at the top showing scrolling probabilities for key markets.
NO ROUNDED CORNERS: Override Shadcn default radius to '0.125rem' (2px) or '0px' in 'theme.extend.borderRadius'.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use Bento grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers only.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside containers, but keep the grid gap tight (density).
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays can enhance the 'Tactile' feel.
